stem: A 4-year-old with nephrotic syndrome has very marked oedema despite a no added salt diet; what additional supportive measure may be needed?
explanation: Fluid restriction may be needed in a child with nephrotic syndrome who has gross oedema. It is an additional supportive measure alongside dietary salt restriction when fluid overload is significant.

optionExplanations.A: Correct because fluid restriction may be needed when oedema is very marked in nephrotic syndrome.
optionExplanations.B: Incorrect because angiography is not a supportive measure for managing oedema in nephrotic syndrome.
optionExplanations.C: Incorrect because circumcision is unrelated to nephrotic syndrome and its oedema management.
optionExplanations.D: Incorrect because regular voiding advice is relevant to urinary symptoms and UTI prevention, not nephrotic oedema.
optionExplanations.E: Incorrect because probiotics are not used to manage oedema in nephrotic syndrome.
